_design_note: M3.4. The sole change from m3_3l_r02_3_a06_e01_t02_n5_v3_2000 is that training and primary evaluation now face three rule_based_agent opponents instead of playing solo. Route R02_3, handcrafted_v3, A06, shaping, E01, task T02, n=5, the fitted-Q recipe, the 2000-round budget, the seeds and the checkpoint protocol are unchanged. Keeping the task at loot-crate is deliberate: it isolates the opponents as the one changed factor, and leaves the coin signal at the density that was shown to be learnable. The classic_versus_opponents suite is the actual tournament setting and classic_solo is the bridge back to the solo arms.
